name: Li-Ri
tagline: Kids game, drive a toy wood engine
blurb: Li-Ri is a arcade game where you drive a toy wood engine in many levels and you must collect all the coaches for win.
description:
Li-Ri is a arcade game where you drive a toy wood engine in many levels and you must collect all the coaches for win. You can download it and play indefinitely.

It's Free and licensed under the GPL (General Public License). You can play on 'Windows', 'Linux', 'Mac OsX', 'Android'.

• 19 languages: Arabic, Breton, Chinese, English, Esperanto, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Polish, Turkish, Hungarian, Dutch.

• 50 levels in this version.

• 3 beautiful musics and many sound effects.

Li-Ri is a fork of Ri-li.
